text:
```yaml
name: Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  lint-test:
    uses: jmanhype/github-actions/.github/workflows/ci.yml@main

  release:
    needs: lint-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    concurrency:
      group: release
      cancel-in-progress: false
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Release with release-please
        uses: googleapis/release-please-action@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          release-type: simple
          path: .
          target-branch: main
```
